purpose: Executable ledger for the `cosmological-background-vacuum-history` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Thermal-history rows separate inflation, reheating, BBN, recombination, structure formation, and source-population history from generic cosmological support or ToE closure.

thermal_history_rows.epoch_or_transition_object: Inflation, reheating, radiation era, BBN, recombination, structure formation, source-population history, detector/catalog epoch, or benchmark history claimed by FAMILYC-EW-CODE.
thermal_history_rows.inflation_reheating_bbn_rule: Name the epoch sequence and transition mechanism: inflation/reheating, baryogenesis/leptogenesis proxy, radiation era, BBN, recombination, reionization, or metadata-only convention. A successful late-time fit does not recover early thermal history.
thermal_history_rows.structure_formation_or_growth_gap: Structure-formation, growth, sigma8/S8, halo, baryonic-feedback, foreground, source-population, and survey-selection debts remain live until the route states which public record and nuisance stack carry the claim.
thermal_history_rows.timing_or_observed_abundance_gap: Light-element abundances, CMB acoustic peaks, BAO, large-scale structure, and source catalogs are separate records. Agreement with one epoch cannot compensate for failure in another without declared transport and composition rows.
thermal_history_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer complete cosmological history, successful reheating, BBN recovery, structure-formation recovery, or candidate-native cosmology from a route-local thermal-history row alone.
